---

## 📌 Documentation Index

- 📖 **User Manual**: [User Guide (USER_GUIDE.md)](https://github.com/Aurora-Nasa-1/CPPlayer-KMP/blob/HEAD/docs/USER_GUIDE.md) (installation, importing audio sources, account login, push notifications, FAQ)

## iOS App Maintenance

Free Apple ID signing typically expires after 7 days. When the app won't open after expiration, reconnect the iPhone and press `Cmd + R` in Xcode to reinstall and renew the signing for 7 more days:

```bash
cd /Users/max/Desktop/github/interview
source ~/.nvm/nvm.sh && nvm use 22
npx cap open ios
```

If you're only renewing the signing without changing content, you don't need to rebuild the web artifacts.

If you've modified the blog content, you need to rebuild and sync first:

```bash
cd /Users/max/Desktop/github/interview

source ~/.nvm/nvm.sh && nvm use 16.19.1
MOBILE=1 npm run docs:build

source ~/.nvm/nvm.sh && nvm use 22.22.2
npx cap sync ios
npx cap open ios
```

Then select iPhone in Xcode and press `Cmd + R` to install.

Ray-hola/work-calendar.body:
# Work Calendar

**Strategy Team Ledger**: A self-hosted team task and project collaboration workbench. One Python file, one SQLite database, zero runtime dependencies, and your data stays only on your own machine.

[Quick Start](#快速开始) · [Docker](#docker) · [Features](#功能) · [Where to Change Code](#改代码去哪里) · [English](https://github.com/Ray-hola/work-calendar/blob/HEAD/README.en.md)

## Why This Project

Most collaboration tools require storing task, daily report, and member data on third-party clouds. Work Calendar puts the complete task lifecycle (schedule → execute → complete → archive) and collaboration rules into one auditable local service: `server.py` plus a SQLite file. The page is accessed through a local port, and when external access is needed, it is published via Cloudflare Tunnel or a reverse proxy.

## Features

**Tasks**
- Three task types: project tasks, ad-hoc tasks (not attached to a project; members can create them for themselves, and admins can assign them to others), and fixed schedules (daily / weekdays / specific weekdays / monthly / specific dates; can be attached to a project, and individual days can be excluded).
- Completion ends the task with no approval required: the assignee can edit the completion record, and the project Owner or an admin can send it back with a stated reason.
- Tasks not finished by the end of the day (including fixed schedules) automatically roll over to the next day. The old day is hidden and excluded from statistics. Tasks can also be manually postponed to a specified date.
- When assigning a task, the other person's already-scheduled hours are shown based on the task's own start and end times.

**Projects**
- Members apply to join projects, and admins approve. Project settings allow changing the name, dates, and collaborators; admins can also change the Owner.
- Tasks within a project can be sorted by priority or by start / end time, or dragged manually. The project timeline is displayed on a unified date scale.
- Closing a project requires submitting a report and approval from a superadmin. After closing, the project enters the results library.

**Collaboration and Records**
- The inbox is isolated per recipient. The communication area has a public channel and a channel for each project, with @mention support.
- Journal and statistics: every day at 23:30, a summary of each person's completions and workload load is generated.
- Desktop widget: a pinnable picture-in-picture mini window showing today's to-dos, with a Pomodoro timer (Chrome / Edge desktop).
- AI assistant (optional): admins configure an OpenAI-compatible endpoint. The key is stored only on the server.

**Interface and Permissions**
- Layouts for desktop, tablet, and mobile.
- Tiered authorization for superadmin, admins, project Owners, and collaborators. Out-of-scope operations are rejected by the server. Account management is visible only to admins, and account switching lists only accounts that have logged in from this browser.

## Requirements

- **Python 3.11+**, no third-party dependencies (CI runs tests on 3.11 and 3.12).
- Windows needs timezone data: `python -m pip install tzdata`.
- **Node.js 18+**: only needed to run frontend tests. CI…

# Babel v1.3

This is an open-source AI-native Chiplet design flow, based on an open-source EDA toolchain and AI Coding Agents.

#Synchronized updates
https://www.gitlink.org.cn/amoslee2011/Babel
https://github.com/amoslee2026/Babel

## Learning Tutorial

A complete learning tutorial for electronic engineering graduates (16 chapters), covering the full AI-native chip design workflow:

👉 [tutorial/](https://github.com/amoslee2026/Babel/blob/HEAD/tutorial/)

| Part | Chapters | Topic |
|------|------|------|
| I. Paradigm and Preparation | 01-04 | AI-native paradigm, prerequisite knowledge, learning with omp, human-AI collaboration modes |
| II. Specification-Driven Design | 05-07 | PRD, architecture design, Micro-Architecture Specification (MAS) |
| III. AI Implementation Flow | 08-11 | RTL generation, verification loop, logic synthesis, physical design |
| IV-V. Tools and Practice | 12-16 | EDA toolchain, NPU hands-on walkthrough, debugging, glossary, further reading |

## Innovations and Core Features

### 1. AI-Native Chiplet Design Paradigm

The first fully open-source chip design flow "driven by an AI Coding Agent," automating everything from natural-language requirements to GDSII signoff through Agents. It moves away from traditional IC design, which relies on senior engineers iterating by hand, and uses specialized Agents in place of manual effort across the design, verification, synthesis, and physical design stages.

### 2. 5-Agent Pipeline + Issue Handoff Protocol

Five specialized Agents collaborate through labeled issues that trigger handoffs. Each Agent has its own iteration convergence limit and an `escalate-user` mechanism, which automatically pauses and requests a human decision when the limit is exceeded. When a downstream stage finds a problem, it can send it back upstream for correction via `*-needs-fix`.

```
User Requirement → [architect] → guru-rtl → guru-verification → guru-synthesis → guru-pd → signoff
              ↑_________________________*-needs-fix feedback loop__________________________|
```

### 3. Spec-Code Bidirectional Traceability System

A three-layer traceability model keeps requirements, code, assertions, and constraints consistent at all times:
- **Layer 1**: RTL file header `@requirement / @spec_hash / @spec_ref`
- **Layer 2**: Embedded SVA assertions `@verifies /…`

# Tencent Cloud Server Purchase Assistant

Automatic ordering tool for Tencent Cloud's “Cloud Selection · Limited-Time Flash Sale” lightweight application servers (38 CNY/year, 4 cores 4GB 3M).

Clicking “Buy Now” manually when the event starts often fails to place an order. This tool does not click on the page. Instead, it calls the `do-goods` interface directly from within the page, with the Cookie and CSRF Token carried by the browser itself.

Event page: https://cloud.tencent.com/act/pro/double11-202611#MS

> The event page slug changes every round (`featured-202607` → `double11-202611` → …). When the page address changes, you only need to change the single `ACTIVITY_URL` line at the top of `seckill.py`. The activity id and product id are fetched automatically at runtime and do not need to be edited manually.

## Environment Setup

Requires Python 3.10 or higher, with the dependencies installed:

```bash
pip install -r requirements.txt
```

This command only installs Python packages. It does not download a browser. If Chrome or Edge is installed locally, it is used directly (the log will show `使用浏览器: 本机 Chrome`). Chromium only needs to be installed if neither is present; see Q3.

## Usage

Double-click `腾讯云服务器抢购助手.bat` to start. It automatically locates the local Python (venv → PATH → py launcher → install directory, verifying the version of each one). If none is found, it prints installation instructions. No manual path configuration is needed.

Console menu:

| Option | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [1] Switch region | Shanghai / Beijing / Guangzhou |
| [2] QR code login | Opens a browser window; after scanning the QR code, the login state is saved automatically |
| [3] Start purchasing | Automatically waits for the most recent event |
| [4] Select session | Specify 10:00 or 15:00 |
| [5] Test order flow | Places a real order for a 109 CNY zone product without paying; cancel the order after testing; do not repeat tests |

After a successful purchase, the order is held for 1 hour. Payment must be completed in the Tencent Cloud console during this period; overdue orders are closed automatically.

## How It Works

**Time calibration**　Reads the Date response header, samples 7 times and takes the median, with an error of about ±0.1 seconds. Calibrates again 3 minutes before the sale starts.

**CSRF Token**　Generated dynamically by the frontend and cannot be read statically. The script injects a hook that intercepts the page's fetch and XHR requests and extracts the token from real requests.

**Runtime product id lookup**　Tencent changes `activity_id` and `act_id` for every new event. Hardcoding them returns `1101001` 秒杀尚未开始 (flash sale not yet started). qianqianhaiou/ClipKnife.body:
# ClipKnife (素刀)

> Find every frame of inspiration scattered across your hard drives with a single sentence
>
> Chinese | [English](https://github.com/qianqianhaiou/ClipKnife/blob/HEAD/README.en.md)

ClipKnife is a natural-language asset management and search tool for Windows, built for creators. Add assets spread across folders, drives, and external hard drives to the asset library. After local indexing is complete, you can search for images or video clips by describing the visuals, then return to the original files to verify, organize, and use them.

**This repository is used for the official website, user manual, changelog, and issue feedback. It does not contain the desktop app's source code.** To use the software, download it from the official website. You do not need to clone this repository or set up a development environment.

- [Official website download](https://clipknife.cn/)
- [User manual](https://clipknife.cn/manual/) · [FAQ](https://clipknife.cn/faq/) · [Changelog](https://clipknife.cn/changelog/)
- [Instructions for searching local videos by content](https://clipknife.cn/scenes/search-video-content/)

## What problems it solves

- You can't remember the file name but remember the image, for example “seaside sunset” or “close-up of red packaging.” These are examples of ways to describe content, not a test of search success rates.
- Assets are spread across multiple directories or drives, and you want to search them from one library.
- Videos are long, and you want to jump from search results to relevant shots, not just find the whole file.
- After you find assets, you need to organize them by project or hand them off to an editing app.

ClipKnife is not a full video editing app. It does not offer cloud sync or real-time multi-user collaborative editing. Search results still need to be checked by opening the original footage. Representative frames may miss brief moments, and automatic classification and person grouping may make mistakes.

## From building a library to using assets

1. Download and install from the official website. Follow the app's prompts to complete online activation and initialize any required components.
2. Start by adding a small asset folder and confirm the path is accessible. Then expand to other asset sources.
3. Wait for scanning and indexing to finish. Images get a visual index. Videos are automatically split into shots, representative frames are extracted, and time segments are linked to the original video. The time needed to build the first library depends on asset size and hardware. No fixed speed is guaranteed.
4. In Smart Search, enter a description of the visuals, or use search by image. To search speech, first turn on the matching transcription switch and complete indexing.
5. Play the matching clips to check the content. Then open the original file, export the clip, or organize it into a project. When sending material to CapCut or Premiere Pro, check the target timeline and version compatibility requirements in the manual.

## Current capabilities and limits

| Capability | What it can do | What to know before use |
|---|---|---|
| Local asset management | Manage images, videos, and audio across multiple asset sources, and track scanning and indexing tasks | If an external drive or source directory is offline, original files may not open |
| Visual search | Find local images and video shots using natural language or an image | Depends on completed indexing. It is not frame-by-frame search, and it cannot guarantee every query will hit… |

qsc20001102/astrbot_plugin_jx3.body:
# astrbot_plugin_jx3

  A comprehensive data query plugin for 剑网3 built on AstrBot.

`astrbot_plugin_jx3` queries 《剑网3》 game data through data sources such as JX3API and JX3BOX. Depending on the feature, it outputs plain text, remote images, HTML-rendered images, image-and-text messages, or results from a two-step interaction. It also provides per-session server binding, per-session access control, real-time event push, session-isolated danger-avoidance records, and visual cache management.

## Features

- Chinese trigger words cover activities, famous weapons (名剑), rankings, trading, factions, characters, encounters (奇遇), Hundred Battles (百战), housing (家园), community, and more.
- Supports plain text, remote images, HTML/Jinja2-rendered images, and image-and-text message chains.
- Commands `宏`, `资历`, and `装备`, as well as the guild, faction, and other ranking lists, use a two-step interaction with a 15-second window. If the user does not respond in time, the first option is selected by default.
- Query images use a unified light, high-contrast theme. Render sharpness, output format, and JPEG quality can be adjusted on the plugin configuration page. All HTML-rendered images display the data timestamp at the bottom.
- Local team and danger-avoidance records are strictly isolated by AstrBot session. Teams support 10-person or 25-person formats, five-person squads, boss markers, and configurable sign-up limits.
- The master switch and individual JX3API real-time event subscriptions can be enabled separately for each AstrBot session.
- Reuses `aiohttp.ClientSession` and handles GET, POST, JSON, image, and paginated requests in one place.
- Requests to JX3BOX's Node, Next2, and CMS endpoints are wrapped in a unified layer. Base item data for the trading market supports a local snapshot cache with fallback to expired data.
- JX3API queries use a two-level JSON cache (memory and SQLite), and HTML query images use a local file cache. Cache duration, in-memory interface capacity, the SQLite interface cache entry limit, and the total image cache size can all be configured in the WebUI.
- Includes 117 built-in Chinese trigger commands and 53 page fragments. They are assembled locally into complete HTML through a shared layout and stylesheet, and ship with general, sandbox (沙盘), sect/mental art (门派/心法), and encounter icon resources.

## Data Sources

| Data Source | Code Entry | Main Uses |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [JX3API](https://www.jx3api.com/) | `core/jx3api_data.py`、`core/event_push.py` | Game queries, qualification distribution, sandbox stronghold data, and WebSocket real-time events |
| [JX3BOX](https://www.jx3box.com/) | `core/jx3box_data.py` | Encounter guides, gear setups, macros, and trading market |
| Local SQLite | `core/sqlite.py`、`core/team.py`、`core/team_rules.py`、`core/bilei_data.py`、`core/cache.py` | Teams, sign-up rules, session configuration, aliases, danger-avoidance records, event subscriptions, interface cache, and image cache index |…

## What this project is

30nama does not have a native, up-to-date app for Mac, Windows, Android TV, or Apple TV. This project fills that gap with four apps that work with your own account at [30nama.com](https://30nama.com).

# Voxy Server Side NeoForge

[0.3.6 Changelog](https://github.com/wish131400/voxy-server-side-neoforge/blob/HEAD/CHANGELOG.md) · [Usage and Upgrade Guide](https://github.com/wish131400/voxy-server-side-neoforge/blob/HEAD/docs/release-0.3.6-player-guide.md) · [Mod Compatibility Review](https://github.com/wish131400/voxy-server-side-neoforge/blob/HEAD/docs/release-0.3.5-mod-compatibility-20261006.md)

Voxy Server Side (VSS) lets the server handle reading, generating, caching, and sending Voxy distant LOD. Clients only request missing or outdated column data, then hand it to Voxy for rendering. It suits multiplayer servers, large modpacks, and high-speed movement scenarios.

## Supported Versions

| Item | Version |
| --- | --- |
| Minecraft | `1.21.1` |
| Loader | NeoForge `21.1.x` |
| VSS | `0.3.6-neoforge-1.21.1` |
| Voxy version verified in this round | `0.2.15-beta`, NeoForge 1.21.1 |

- Forge 1.20.1 version: [voxy-server-side-forge](https://github.com/wish131400/voxy-server-side-forge)
- Download: [CurseForge](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/voxy-server-side-forge-neoforge)

The current version is `0.3.6-neoforge-1.21.1`, and the output file is `lib/vss-0.3.6-neoforge-1.21.1.jar`. The current NeoForge network protocol is 53. Clients and servers must use the same 0.3.6 build; older protocols are incompatible. Cache upgrades are verified and migrated per record, so you do not need to clear the world or the Voxy cache.

Clients and servers must install VSS with matching protocol versions. When updating, use the JAR from the same build, and do not judge compatibility based only on the mod version number.

## Installation

The server needs:

- NeoForge `21.1.x`
- VSS
- Optional but recommended (bandwidth compression mod): [ZstdNet](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/zstdnet)

The client needs:

- NeoForge `21.1.x`
- VSS…
